identificationModule.briefTitle: Sac-TMT Combined With Bevacizumab in TNBC With Brain Metastases
identificationModule.officialTitle: An Open-label, Single-arm, Multi-center Phase II Study of Sacituzumab Tirumotecan (Sac-TMT) Combined With Bevacizumab in Triple-negative Breast Cancer Patients With Brain Metastases

descriptionModule.briefSummary: This is a single-arm, multi-center phase II study to evaluate the safety and efficacy Sacituzumab Tirumotecan (Sac-TMT) plus bevacizumab in triple-negative breast cancer patients with brain metastases. Twenty-four participants are planned to be enrolled. The eligible patients should have histologically or cytologically confirmed TNBC with BM.

designInfo.interventionModelDescription:
This is a single-arm, multi-center phase II study to evaluate the safety and efficacy Sacituzumab Tirumotecan (Sac-TMT) plus bevacizumab in triple-negative breast cancer patients with brain metastases. Twenty-four participants are planned to be enrolled. The eligible patients should have histologically or cytologically confirmed TNBC with BM.

This study includes a safety run-in period followed by an expansion cohort. The safety run-in period will employ the mTPI-2 (modified toxicity probability interval-2) design for an initial safety assessment.

In Dose Expansion stage, 24 eligible patients will receive a dosage of sac-TMT 4mg/kg Q2W and the recommended dosage of bevacizumab in safety run-in period. Treatment will continue until disease progression or unacceptable toxicity.

The primary endpoint is CNS ORR and secondary endpoints include CNS CBR, systemic ORR, PFS, OS, safety and tolerability.

interventions.name: Sacituzumab Tirumotecan (Sac-TMT)
interventions.description: Eligible patients will receive a dosage of sac-TMT 4mg/kg Q2W

interventions.name: bevacizumab
interventions.description:
safety run-in phase: bevacizumab 10mg/kg D1 Q2W

Dose expansion phase: bevacizumab RP2D D1 Q2W

primaryOutcomes.description: The proportion of patients who have a CR or PR in the CNS, as determined by the Investigator according to RANO-BM criteria
primaryOutcomes.timeFrame: from enrollment to progression or death (for any reason), assessed up to 24 months

secondaryOutcomes.description: CNS clinical benefit rate (CBR) will be defined as the percentage of patients who experience a CR, PR or Stable Disease (SD) for at least 24 weeks.
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: from enrollment to progression or death (for any reason), assessed up to 24 months

secondaryOutcomes.description: PFS will be defined as the time from the first dose of treatment to death or disease progression
OS will be defined as the time from the first dose of treatment to death for any cause

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Safety as assessed by percentage of patients with any Adverse Event
secondaryOutcomes.description: Adverse event according to NCI-CTC AE 5.0
